draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Cheruthoni! The 138 metre Cheruthoni Dam here holds the spillway for the whole Idukki Reservoir, and Asia's tallest double curvature arch dam stands just 1 km away.
draft.hungryLine: This is a working hill town, so expect simple Kerala meals and tea shops rather than anything fancy.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Head to the Cheruthoni Dam, then go 1 km east to see the Idukki Arch Dam squeezed between two granite hills.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a spot looking over the reservoir, which spreads over 60 square km up in the hills.
moodReplies.surprise-me: This town only began in the 1940s, when farmers were allowed to clear land in these hills after a famine.

spots.name: Cheruthoni Dam
spots.detail: Short drive · 138 m concrete dam with the reservoir's spillway

spots.name: Idukki township
spots.detail: 21 min walk · Home of the Idukki Arch Dam, with the Periyar running through

legends.title: The first settlers
legends.body: People here tell how farmers came up into the empty hills in the 1940s after a famine. They cleared the land for farming, and the town grew from there.

tips.title: Pack for rain.
tips.body: Kerala gets rain for at least seven to eight months a year, and these hills are no exception.

tips.title: Know your dams.
tips.body: Cheruthoni Dam is 1 km west of the Idukki Arch Dam, and together with Kulamavu they make one reservoir.

story.title: Farmers in the hills
story.body: After a famine, the government let farmers move to unoccupied land in these mountains. They cleared it for farming.

story.title: A spot for power
story.body: The region was picked as an ideal place for a hydroelectric project. Hindustan Construction Company built the dams for the Kerala State Electricity Board.

story.title: The dams go up
story.body: Cheruthoni Dam was finished as part of the Idukki Hydroelectric Project, with help from Canadian loans and grants. Three dams now hold back one big reservoir.

story.title: A medical college
story.body: The Government Medical College, Idukki opened its campus in Cheruthoni.
